categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Changes `contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py`, which is release verification tooling covered under build release integrity.
categories.rationale: Expired or revoked keys were counted toward the signature verification threshold, allowing release verification to succeed without active signing keys. Release integrity is the top priority for build tooling, making this Red Team security finding category-critical to resolve promptly.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Scripts and tools' and modifies standalone verification utility scripts in `contrib/verify-binaries/`.
categories.rationale: Fixes a security-relevant flaw where `verify.py` accepted expired and revoked GPG keys as good signatures to meet quorum. Downstream users and operators depend on this script to accurately validate binary authenticity before installation.
